title: Entry envelope (docs/content-model.md#entry-envelope)
description: Fixed keys, tags, meta, and image for every entry in every ruleset. `stats` is validated by the ruleset's type schema.

ruleset.description: The ruleset: a folder in rulesets/ and a key in config/types.json, such as "dnd-5e-2024".

type.description: The entry's type, listed in the ruleset's ruleset.json, such as "creature".

id.description: The slug of the name at creation. Unique within the type, equal to the file name, and never changed after merge.

name.description: Display name, unique within the type ignoring case. For an SRD entry, the SRD name exactly.

summary.description: One plain-text line, used on cards, in PR bodies, and in link previews.

description.description: Lore and flavor in the markdown subset; not rules text. Omitted on SRD entries.

stats.description: Rules data, validated by the ruleset's schema for the type. Inputs only, never a derived value.

tags.description: Open, flat organization; every key is a gallery filter. Conventional keys: world, campaign, theme, environment, author.

image.description: Path to the entry's art, which must exist. Omitted when there is none.

meta.description: Provenance, shown on the detail page.

createdAt.description: The date the entry was created.

updatedAt.description: The date of the latest revision.

kind.description: "routine" for a generated entry, "revise" for a revision, "manual" for a hand-made entry.

gapFill.description: The gap bucket's label, when gap fill created the entry.

srd.description: Set on an SRD entry, reproduced unmodified from SRD 5.2; omitted on a custom entry.
